title: CoreWeave collapses after Gartner predicts 80% of neoclouds will evaporate by 2030
key_facts: Neocloud stocks fell on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 after a Gartner report.
CoreWeave fell 15% by noon, DigitalOcean 14%, Hut 8 10%, Nebius and IREN 9%.
Gartner predicts more than 80% of neocloud providers will not survive as independent businesses much beyond 2030.
AI providers are expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 and $6 trillion more between 2027 and 2030.
Data center owners need a cumulative $8.5 trillion of revenue by 2030 to cover costs and a 12% return; forecast AI data center revenue is $3.6 trillion.
More than $4 trillion in asset value could be exposed to write-down risk through 2032.
Hyperscalers such as Amazon, Google and Microsoft are in a better position to survive.
quote_evidence: Neocloud stocks entered a tailspin on Wednesday after a report by Gartner predicted 80% of neoclouds will cease independent operations by 2030 if AI infrastructure spending continues at its breakneck speed.
"However, our research indicates that enterprise and consumer AI revenue will be insufficient to support profitable returns on all planned AI capital expenditures during this period."
why_it_matters_hint: A forecast that AI data center revenue may not cover the spending.
notes: One forecast; conditional on spending continuing.
